methodology.model: Realistic operational completion: software capability plus evidence-readiness, while genuine live-source coverage is reported separately and never inferred from Production GREEN.
methodology.weighting: equal weight across 36 AI Data Platform operational categories
methodology.buildRule: Every numbered build must move this operational denominator by 5-10 percentage points unless the denominator is deliberately re-baselined first.
methodology.liveEvidenceRule: Build 426 measures live runtime/probe functionality, but genuine signed-source coverage is reported separately and missing enrollment never becomes CONNECTED.

categories.name: Master command center & operator visibility
categories.rationale: Live runtime health and seven-source probe results now occupy the primary operating view.

categories.name: Data collection & intake
categories.rationale: Real refresh operations collect current runtime, migration, performance and peer-source evidence.

categories.name: Data review & approval
categories.rationale: Probe and telemetry results are independently separated from owner acceptance instead of prefilled previews.

categories.name: Data quality & validation
categories.rationale: Bounded probes, exact source admission, freshness, HTTP status and verification state are measured at runtime.

categories.name: Provenance & lineage
categories.rationale: Live snapshots bind the deployed commit, source app, observed origin, database state and signed receipt lineage.

categories.name: Search & reporting
categories.rationale: Current runtime statistics, source reachability and first rollups are visible without reading build documents.

categories.name: Corrective operations & reconciliation
categories.rationale: Operators can refresh stale evidence and immediately see HOLD reasons without mutating peer applications.

categories.name: Application registry & module lifecycle
categories.rationale: All seven sources have runtime probe definitions and exact source identities; unconfigured private origins stay explicit.

categories.name: Cross-application data contracts
categories.rationale: Canonical telemetry contracts are exercised by actual HTTPS probes when credentials and origins are available.

categories.name: Event bus, delivery & replay
categories.rationale: Valid signed envelopes enter the existing anti-replay receipt ledger; failures remain non-authorizing evidence.

categories.name: Source onboarding, signer & trust
categories.rationale: Runtime probe support plus existing pinned signer verification makes live enrollment executable rather than illustrative.

categories.name: Connector setup & diagnostics
categories.rationale: Origin reachability, auth configuration, telemetry HTTP state, latency and signed-envelope admission are measured separately.

categories.name: Shared identity & customer resolution
categories.rationale: Source identity stays exact-app/exact-revision while live operational identity evidence is now observable.

categories.name: Shared scheduling & work queue
categories.rationale: Queue depth and completed/failed work become first statistical-rollup inputs when sources report them.

categories.name: Tenant/workspace isolation & authorization
categories.rationale: Live dashboards remain owner/operator scoped and refresh writes are append-only under RLS.

categories.name: Consent & notification governance
categories.rationale: No communication or consent authority is inferred from telemetry reachability or signed statistics.

categories.name: Data classification
categories.rationale: Only NON_SENSITIVE_AGGREGATE telemetry is accepted into live rollups.

categories.name: Encryption & secret custody
categories.rationale: Read-token values are read only from server environment and never stored; signer pins remain public evidence.

categories.name: Redaction & data minimization
categories.rationale: Peer responses are bounded and only approved aggregate metric keys enter rollups.

categories.name: Retention & expiry
categories.rationale: Runtime snapshots and probe events are time-stamped, append-only and naturally age into stale evidence.

categories.name: Deletion evidence & legal holds
categories.rationale: Live operations add no destructive deletion path; evidence history remains append-only.

categories.name: DLP & export controls
categories.rationale: Telemetry probes authorize no export or mutation and cross-tenant payloads remain excluded.

categories.name: Privileged operations & owner gates
categories.rationale: Refresh is a read-only operational action; consequential operations remain under existing owner gates.

categories.name: Audit & evidence immutability
categories.rationale: Migration 0189 adds append-only runtime, probe and rollup ledgers with FORCE RLS.

categories.name: Incident response, recovery & rollback
categories.rationale: Current backup/recovery/restart observations can enter the live operating picture when sources genuinely report them.

categories.name: Performance & capacity governance
categories.rationale: Real 24-hour API counts/failures/p95, DB-pool pressure and peer latency are displayed from production evidence.

categories.name: Desktop UX & accessibility
categories.rationale: The live command surface uses existing accessible desktop components and current runtime values.

categories.name: Tablet UX & accessibility
categories.rationale: Responsive status cards reduce dense evidence review on tablet while keeping exact states visible.

categories.name: Mobile UX & accessibility
categories.rationale: Compact live metrics and source-state cards improve mobile usefulness without hiding HOLD states.

categories.name: Offline/degraded-network resilience
categories.rationale: Timeouts, failed probes and unavailable private origins fail closed without destructive retries.

categories.name: Theme & design system
categories.rationale: Build 426 stays on the shared Master theme contract while replacing placeholder cards with current values.

categories.name: Workflow automation & AI suggestions
categories.rationale: Manual refresh performs supervised, bounded GET-only collection and signed-envelope admission with no source action.

categories.name: External runtime/original-host evidence
categories.rationale: AI Hub remains the only host-reboot authority; its private origin can be configured without inventing Vercel access.

categories.name: Cross-application live operational evidence
categories.rationale: Real peer reachability and signed-source admission are now executable; genuine connected-source count remains separately measured.

categories.name: Release/CI/migration engineering
categories.rationale: Adds migration 0189, Build 426 verifier, exact-source promotion and runtime probe instrumentation.

categories.name: Documentation, help & runbooks
categories.rationale: Documents real production origins, environment-only secret custody, refresh behavior and the remaining 100% closure gap.
